notes:
POC scope: 2-week evaluation starting on hosted API to validate model quality, then transition to Dedicated VPC for latency/throughput tests. Primary workload: customer-facing chat + retrieval-augmented responses; embeddings for search index updates (daily batch).

Key non-functional targets: P99 latency <= 250ms (chat short-turns), sustained throughput target ~30 QPS, embedding throughput 200 reqs/min batch; cost sensitivity = moderate-high (want unit-cost estimates for dedicated tiers).

Security/comments: Mossfield is mid-market SaaS with EU customers — needs data residency for EU region for subset of tenants. Must provide SOC2 Type II report and evidence. Okta is their IdP; they require SSO/SAML for console plus IdP-initiated SSO. Audit logs retention requested = 13 months (min), with export to customer's SIEM (syslog/S3). KMS integration required for customer-managed keys (HSM optional).

Quotes from calls: "We can't move forward until SOC2 artifacts and a clear VPC peering diagram are in place." — Head of Platform (Mossfield).

POC success criteria: reproduce query latency targets on Dedicated with KV cache enabled; embedding recall >= baseline; no PII leaks in outputs; smooth SAML login during CSM demo.

Operational notes: testing dataset anonymized; invoice cadence preference = quarterly; legal asks for 45 day review of Redwood DPA.

Sales/ops: AE placed 3 dedicated pricing options in Drive; finance to pick commit size. Next internal: coordinate infra architect (Redwood) with Mossfield network team to finalize peering and CIDR ranges.
product_requirements_summary: Workload: chat + RAG + daily embedding updates. Preferred models: open-model family but willing to test Redwood-verified weights; need routing/fallback to smaller quantized variant when capacity constrained. Latency SLOs: P50 < 100ms, P95 < 180ms, P99 < 250ms. Throughput SLO: burst up to 60 QPS, sustained 25-30 QPS. Caching: require prefix/KV cache; sticky sessions for chat. Retention: conversation transcripts masked after 30 days by default; audit logs retained 13 months. Compliance: SOC2 Type II, SSO via Okta, KMS (customer-managed), VPC peering and private IP egress.
